items.title_zh: Over 41,000 U.S. Homeland Security officials' details apparently exposed after massive data breach
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：The identities of over 41,000 officials from the Department of Homeland Security have allegedly been exposed in a massive data breach by a hacktivist group calling itself the Department of Peace.；Late Wednesday stateside, the database was posted on Distributed Denial of Secrets, a nonprofit dedicated to news leaks, with claims that it was obtained from an Okta single sign-on service used by the DHS.；It appears to reveal employee names, offices, contact information and assignments, and is searchable.
important_points: The identities of over 41,000 officials from the Department of Homeland Security have allegedly been exposed in a massive data breach by a hacktivist group calling itself the Department of Peace.

Late Wednesday stateside, the database was posted on Distributed Denial of Secrets, a nonprofit dedicated to news leaks, with claims that it was obtained from an Okta single sign-on service used by the DHS.
It appears to reveal employee names, offices, contact information and assignments, and is searchable.

items.title: 微软最新财报出炉： Azure增长48%，设备收入低于预期
items.title_zh: 微软最新财报出炉： Azure增长48%，设备收入低于预期
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：{{aisd}} AI生成 免责声明 当地时间10月28日，微软在盘后公布了2027财年第一财季（截至9月30日）的财报。；财报显示，该财季微软营收为923亿美元，同比增长19%。净利润为366亿美元，按美国通用会计准则（GAAP）计算增长32%。受财报表现影响，微软股价盘后上涨了2.9%。；微软董事长兼首席执行官Satya Nadella（萨蒂亚·纳德拉）表示：“通过帮助企业构建并掌控自身的智能，并通过保障智能体的安全与可靠赢得信任，我们正在将创新转化为各行各业日益增长的应用和实际影响。” 这一业绩披露是微软调整财报披露结构后发布的首份财报。微软从此前的三个报告部门（生产力和业务流程、智能云、更多个人计算）改为两个部门：“智能体和基础设施”与“设备和消费者”。

items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at its October meeting, even as rising energy costs threaten to keep inflation elevated and further strain already-tight household budgets.；Higher energy prices stemming from the Iran war may prove stickier than expected, but the central bank's decision to hold rates steady gives policymakers more time to assess the economic fallout.；The dynamic could also lead Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee to consider raising rates at their December meeting in order to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target.
important_points: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at its October meeting, even as rising energy costs threaten to keep inflation elevated and further strain already-tight household budgets.
Higher energy prices stemming from the Iran war may prove stickier than expected, but the central bank's decision to hold rates steady gives policymakers more time to assess the economic fallout.
The dynamic could also lead Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee to consider raising rates at their December meeting in order to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target.

items.title_zh: 10-year Treasury yield creeps higher even as Fed keeps rates the same
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Bond yields moved higher on Wednesday as investors digested the Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady at its October meeting.；The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was more than 3 basis points higher at 5.026%.；The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which more closely follows short-term Federal Reserve rate decisions, slipped more than 3 basis points to 4.704%.
important_points: Bond yields moved higher on Wednesday as investors digested the Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady at its October meeting.
The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was more than 3 basis points higher at 5.026%.
The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which more closely follows short-term Federal Reserve rate decisions, slipped more than 3 basis points to 4.704%.
